chunks: The venerable Shaykh Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babawayh al-Qummi (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd b. Abdullah narrated to us from Ahmad b. Abi Abdullah. He said: Muhammad b. Tasnim narrated to me from al-Abbas b. Amer from Ibn Bukayr from Salam b. Ghanim from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad from his forefathers (peace be upon them). The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:

Whoever sweeps a mosque, Allah will record for him the freeing of a slave. And whoever removes from it something that irritates an eye, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will record for him a double portion of His mercy.

key_terms.عِتْقَ رَقَبَةٍ: The freeing of a slave -- an immense reward in Islamic law
key_terms.قَمَّ: To sweep -- referring to cleaning the mosque floor
key_terms.كِفْلَيْنِ مِنْ رَحْمَتِهِ: A double portion of His mercy -- emphasizing the magnified reward

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for sweeping a mosque according to Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: This prophetic tradition, narrated through a chain reaching the Prophet (S) via Imam al-Sadiq (AS), establishes the spiritual reward for maintaining the cleanliness of mosques. Sweeping a mosque earns the equivalent reward of freeing a slave, and removing even small impurities earns double divine mercy. In the context of early Islam, mosques served as central community spaces, so their upkeep was considered a communal act of worship that benefited everyone.
word_analysis: may Allah have mercy on him
may Allah be pleased with him

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father (ra) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us from Ahmad b. Abi `Abdullah. He said: Muhammad b. Tasnim narrated to me from al-`Abbas b. `Amer from Ibn Bukayr from Salam b. Ghanim from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his forefathers (as). The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
Whomever sweeps up a mosque, Allah will record the freeing of a slave for him. Whoever comes out of it with something in his eye (a speck of dust), Allah will record double His mercy for him.
